title: Imaginarity Resource Theory of Gaussian Quantum Channels
summary: Complex numbers play an indispensable role in quantum mechanics and quantum information, as validated by both theoretical analysis and experimental verification. Since quantum information processing inherently relies on quantum channels, the resource theory for quantum channels is equally fundamental to that for quantum states. In this paper, we propose two frameworks for quantifying the imaginarity of Gaussian channels. The first framework regards all real superchannels as free superchannels.
